title: A Dynamic Multiplexing Policy for a Quantum Repeater
summary: We consider a multiplexed quantum repeater that distributes entanglement between two end nodes. Multiplexing is achieved through optical integration of many quantum chips. Each chip hosts an optically addressable communication qubit and a separate memory qubit. The communication qubit serves as an entanglement generation interface between different quantum chips, and the memory qubit can be used to store entanglement.
